entry.summary: RT goodalexander There’s this concept that took me forever to learn A lot of the best traders are poker players or sports betting enthusiasts. They’re focused on maximizing their statistical edge. And they love franchises that allow them to “pursue their art”. They’re gamers If you’re running a franchise - you want to fill it with people like this. The people who tend to look at the world this way think they’re “playing the greatest game ever invented”.
